programme.title: We are the Millers / Wir sind die Millers

For the project, David is committed to camouflage his neighbor, the dance woman Rose, to step in for the two children as a wife and mother. programme.title: Football - World Cup qualifications / Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - M: Tel First League of the Federation of BiH / Fudbal - m:tel Prva liga Federacije BIH
programme.desc: The first League of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina in football is one of the two second instance levels of the football competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina and the first rank of competition in the Federation of BiH. League was founded in 2000. and consists of 16 clubs, the winner of the league is placed in the Prime Minister of Bosnia and Herzegovina, while (depending on the FBiH Prime Minister or RS) three or five Leagues of the FBiH (north, center, south or west) depending on the geographical location of the place from which they come. / Prva liga Federacije Bosne i Hercegovine u nogometu je jedan od dva drugostepena nivoa nogometnog takmičenja u Bosni i Hercegovini i prvi rang takmičenja u Federaciji BiH. Liga je osnovana 2000. godine i sastoji se od 16 klubova, pobjednik lige se plasira u Premijer ligu Bosne i Hercegovine dok (u zavisnosti da li su klubovi koji ispadaju iz Premijer lige iz FBiH ili RS) tri ili pet posljednjih timova lige ispada u jednu od Drugih liga FBiH (Sjever, Centar, Jug ili Zapad) zavisno od geografskog položaja mjesta iz kojeg dolaze.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - World Cup qualifications / Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: American Football - NFL / Američki fudbal - NFL
programme.desc: The largest and most popular American football league in the world's NFL was founded in 1920. years, but only by merging with competing AFL in the middle of the last century, today's version of the competition was created. 32 teams divided into two conferences in the league. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podijeljene u dvije konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plej-of do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - World Cup qualifications / Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - World Cup qualifications / Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Judo: World Cup: Finals, Team / Джудо: Световно първенство: финали, отборно
programme.desc: The event is one of the most prestigious competitions in the sport, organized by the International Judo Federation (IJF). It brings together the best Judlers from all over the world who compete for the title of world champion in different categories. The first World Cup was held in 1956. / Събитието е едно от най-престижните състезания в спорта, което се организира от Международната федерация по джудо (IJF). То събира най-добрите джудисти от цял свят, които се състезават за титлата световен шампион в различни категории. Първото световно първенство се провежда през 1956 година.

programme.title: Cycling: A Czech Tour / Колоездене: Обиколка на Чехия
programme.desc: The Sazka Tour is one of the most famous cycling competitions in the Czech Republic, which is usually held every year in the summer and attracts participants from all over the world. The event is part of the UCI Europe Tour, which makes it meaningful for professional cyclists, as well as for lovers who want to test their skills in this picturesque country. / "Sazka Tour" е едно от най-известните колоездачни състезания в Чехия, което обикновено се провежда всяка година през лятото и привлича участници от цял свят. Събитието е част от UCI Europe Tour, което го прави значимо за професионалните колоездачи, както и за любителите, които искат да изпитат своите умения в тази живописна страна.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Emil Kremenliev / Зала на славата: Емил Кременлиев
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. programme.title: A better life / Един по-добър живот
programme.desc: Yang is a cook in a student chair, but dreams of a wider field. He falls in love with Nasya, a waitress in a restaurant who has a girl. The renovation of the room swallow all their money, all requirements are not met and they cannot open the restaurant. Yang and Nadia are separated, and their debt is being paid. Nadia goes to Canada, received a good offer and leaves Sliman to Yang. Initially, Nadia called often, then only with letters. Yang decides to rent the room to pay off the debt. The school understands that Sliman does not live with his parents and report to social. Yang robs the man who lied to him to sell him the restaurant for a little money, and he and Sliman go to Canada to look for Nadia… / Ян е готвач в ученически стол, но мечтае за по-широко поприще. Той се влюбва в Нася, сервитьорка в рестарант, която има момиченце. Тримата излизат на екскурзия и виждат изоставена къща, която се продава и решават да направят ресторант. За целта вземат кредит, но тъй като нямат никакви пари за начало вземат револвиращи кредити. Ремонтът на помещението гълта всичките им пари, всички изисквания не са изпълнени и те не могат да отворят ресторанта. Ян и Надя се разделят, непосилно им е изплащането на дълговете. Надя заминава за Канада, получила е добра оферта и оставя Слиман на Ян. Първоначално Надя се обажда често, после само с писма. Ян решава да даде помещението под наем, за да изплаща дълга. От училището разбират, че Слиман не живее с родителите си и съобщават на социалните. Ян обира мъжа, който го е излъгал да му продаде ресторанта за малко пари и двамата със Слиман заминават за Канада да търсят Надя…

programme.desc: The true story of the greatest bank robber in Canada history. He was captured in 1988 after years of persecution and after 59 successful robbery. The value of the raised amounts to 2 million and 339 thousand. Police forces unite and organize actions that lead to numerous arrests. Gilbert Galvan - Jr. was originally condemned in the United States, but fleeing the correctional center and ends up in Canada. He initially wants to work to support himself, but soon realizes that there are no armed guards in the banks and begins to do robberies. She meets Andrea and marries her. To secure his family, he begins with robberies. It connects to a local mafia - Tommy Kay. He changed his name to Robert Whitman. He was released from prison in 2001. Там първоначално иска да работи, за да се издържа, но скоро разбира, че в Канада в банките няма въоръжена охрана и започва да прави обири. Среща Андреа и се жени за нея. programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

Prijateljski susreti odličan su način za ispitivanje trenutne snage momčadi i iskušavanje različitih taktičkih varijanti za nadolazeće službene utakmice. Također, prilika su za mlađe neafirmirane igrače iz drugog plana za nametnuti se stručnom kadru. programme.title: Biciklizam - Tour of Provence / Biciklizam - Tour de la Provence
programme.desc: Tour de La Provence - (Sport. Program, France) Tour de La Provence 2025 is held from February 14 to February 16 in the French Provence region. This three -day stage race, categorized as 2.1 in the UCI European Tour, begins in Marseille and ends in Arles. The race includes three stages: the first from Marseille to Saint-Victoret (169.3 KM), the second from Forcalquier to Manovaque (167.3 KM) and the third from Roggnac to Arles (190.6 KM). Participating drivers and teams from all over the world compete for the overall victory, as well as for T -shirts in categories such as the best young driver and best in the mountain stages ... / Tour de la Provence - (sport. program, Francuska) Tour de la Provence 2025 održava se od 14. do 16. veljače u francuskoj regiji Provansa. Ova trodnevna etapna utrka, kategorizirana kao 2.1 na UCI Europe Touru, započinje u Marseilleu i završava u Arlesu. Utrka uključuje tri etape: prvu od Marseillea do Saint-Victoreta (169,3 km), drugu od Forcalquiera do Manosquea (167,3 km) te treću od Rognaca do Arlesa (190,6 km). Sudjelujući vozači i timovi iz cijelog svijeta natječu se za ukupnu pobjedu, kao i za majice u kategorijama poput najboljeg mladog vozača i najboljeg u brdskim etapama...

programme.title: Handball: Sesvete - Dugo Selo, Handball, European League / Rukomet: Sesvete - Dugo Selo, Rukomet, Europska liga
programme.desc: Handball: Mens Ehf European League - (Sport. Program, 2025) The EHF Cup is the most respected club handball championship in Europe and brings together the best European clubs fighting for the prestigious championship title. The 2025/26 season begins with qualifications that run from August 30 to September 7, 2025, and the group stage begins on October 14th. Only the finals will take place at the end of May 2026, and by then the spectators are expecting great matches and top handball! ... / Handball: Mens EHF European League - (sport. program, 2025) EHF kup je najuglednije klupsko rukometno prvenstvo u Europi i okuplja najbolje europske klubove koji se bore za prestižan naslov prvaka. Sezona 2025/26 započinje kvalifikacijama koje traju od 30. kolovoza do 7. rujna 2025. godine, a grupna faza počinje 14. listopada. Samo finale održat će se krajem svibnja 2026. godine, a do tada gledatelje očekuju sjajne utakmice i vrhunski rukomet!...

programme.title: (U -19): Croatia - Czech Republic, Football, Friendly Match / (U-19): Hrvatska - Češka, Nogomet, Prijateljska utakmica
programme.desc: Football: Club Friendly - (Sport. Program, 2025) club seasons in most of the world leagues are divided by two parts, autumn and spring. At the time of summer and winter, the clubs are in the preparatory period and complement the difficult rhythm of training by playing preparatory friendly matches. Friendly meetings are a great way to test the current team of teams and temptation of different tactical variants for the upcoming official matches. Also, they are an opportunity for younger non -affirmed players from the second plan to impose themselves with a professional frame. In friendly meetings, the emphasis is on Fair Play and coaches are allowed to make an unlimited number of changes ... / Football: Club Friendly - (sport. program, 2025) Klupske sezone u većini svjetskih liga podijeljene su dva dijela, jesenski i proljetni. U vrijeme ljeta i zime klubovi su u pripremnom razdoblju te težak ritam treninga upotpunjuju odigravanjem pripremnih prijateljskih utakmica. Prijateljski susreti odličan su način za ispitivanje trenutne snage momčadi i iskušavanje različitih taktičkih varijanti za nadolazeće službene utakmice. Također, prilika su za mlađe neafirmirane igrače iz drugog plana za nametnuti se stručnom kadru. U prijateljskim susretima naglasak je na fair playu te je trenerima dozvoljeno napraviti neograničeni broj izmjena...

programme.title: Karlovac 1919 - Dugopolje, SuperSport First Football League 2025/2026, 4th round / Karlovac 1919 - Dugopolje, SuperSport Prva nogometna liga 2025./2026., 4. kolo
programme.desc: Football - First Croatian League - (Sport. Program, 2025) The first football league is the Croatian Football Competition of the second rank, which was founded in 1991 after the breakup of Yugoslavia. Next year, the first season was played in which the clubs were divided into four regions, and a higher ranking was progressed from each region. With numerous changes to the competition system, this league is known for developing many young players who later affirmed themselves in strong first -team players such as Dinamo, Hajduk and Rijeka ... / Football - First Croatian League - (sport. program, 2025) Prva nogometna liga je hrvatsko nogometno natjecanje drugog ranga koje je osnovano je 1991. godine nakon raspada Jugoslavije. Sljedeće godine je odigrana i prva sezona u kojoj su klubovi bili podijeljeni u četiri regije te je iz svake regije jedan klub napredovao viši rang. Uz brojne izmjene sustava natjecanja, ova liga je poznata po razvoju mnogo mladih igrača koji su se kasnije afirmirali u jakim prvoligašima kao što su Dinamo, Hajduk i Rijeka...

programme.title: Cibalia - Opatija, SuperSport First Football League 2025/2026, 4th round / Cibalia - Opatija, SuperSport Prva nogometna liga 2025./2026., 4. kolo
programme.desc: Football - First Croatian League - (Sport. Program, 2025) The first football league is the Croatian Football Competition of the second rank, which was founded in 1991 after the breakup of Yugoslavia. Next year, the first season was played in which the clubs were divided into four regions, and a higher ranking was progressed from each region. With numerous changes to the competition system, this league is known for developing many young players who later affirmed themselves in strong first -team players such as Dinamo, Hajduk and Rijeka ... / Football - First Croatian League - (sport. program, 2025) Prva nogometna liga je hrvatsko nogometno natjecanje drugog ranga koje je osnovano je 1991. godine nakon raspada Jugoslavije. Sljedeće godine je odigrana i prva sezona u kojoj su klubovi bili podijeljeni u četiri regije te je iz svake regije jedan klub napredovao viši rang. Uz brojne izmjene sustava natjecanja, ova liga je poznata po razvoju mnogo mladih igrača koji su se kasnije afirmirali u jakim prvoligašima kao što su Dinamo, Hajduk i Rijeka...

programme.title: Football / Nogomet
programme.desc: Football: Club Friendly - (Sport. Program, 2025) club seasons in most of the world leagues are divided by two parts, autumn and spring. At the time of summer and winter, the clubs are in the preparatory period and complement the difficult rhythm of training by playing preparatory friendly matches. Friendly meetings are a great way to test the current team of teams and temptation of different tactical variants for the upcoming official matches. Also, they are an opportunity for younger non -affirmed players from the second plan to impose themselves with a professional frame. In friendly meetings, the emphasis is on Fair Play and coaches are allowed to make an unlimited number of changes ... / Football: Club Friendly - (sport. program, 2025) Klupske sezone u većini svjetskih liga podijeljene su dva dijela, jesenski i proljetni. U vrijeme ljeta i zime klubovi su u pripremnom razdoblju te težak ritam treninga upotpunjuju odigravanjem pripremnih prijateljskih utakmica. Prijateljski susreti odličan su način za ispitivanje trenutne snage momčadi i iskušavanje različitih taktičkih varijanti za nadolazeće službene utakmice. Također, prilika su za mlađe neafirmirane igrače iz drugog plana za nametnuti se stručnom kadru. U prijateljskim susretima naglasak je na fair playu te je trenerima dozvoljeno napraviti neograničeni broj izmjena...

programme.title: Two women for all skins / Zwei Frauen fur alle Felle
programme.desc: The mother cow Lotte calves on the courtyard of dairy farmer Dirk Rothe (Peter Schneider). Julia (Meriel Hinsching) can only turn a caesarean section with Muhe and give birth to the veal healthy. When one of Dirks cattle dies on the pasture shortly afterwards, Maja (Bettina Zimmermann) and Julia were alerted: a rare cattle disease threatens the animals? With united power, Dirk, his daughter Lisa (Lilly Barshy), Maja and Julia, have to prevent other cattle from infect. Since Dirk was recently left by his wife Annette (Annett Sawallisch) and wants to study Lisa Medicine, Dirk is faced with being able to continue the farm alone - a thing of impossibility! Behind his family's jerk, he takes out sales negotiations that threaten to fail when even more animals get sick. Dirk's existence is at stake. Will Maja and Julia also be able to save the future of the family business in addition to the animals? / Auf dem Hof des Milchbauern Dirk Rothe (Peter Schneider) kalbt die Mutterkuh Lotte. Julia (Meriel Hinsching) kann nur mit Muhe einen Kaiserschnitt abwenden und das Kalb gesund zur Welt bringen. Als kurz darauf eines von Dirks Rindern auf der Weide verendet, sind Maja (Bettina Zimmermann) und Julia alarmiert: Bedroht eine seltene Rinderseuche die Tiere? Mit vereinten Kraften mussen Dirk, seine Tochter Lisa (Lilly Barshy), Maja und Julia verhindern, dass sich noch weitere Rinder infizieren. Da Dirk vor Kurzem von seiner Frau Annette (Annett Sawallisch) verlassen wurde und Lisa Medizin studieren will, sieht sich Dirk damit konfrontiert, den Hof alleine weiterfuhren zu mussen - ein Ding der Unmoglichkeit! Hinter dem Rucken seiner Familie nimmt er Verkaufsverhandlungen auf, die zu scheitern drohen, als noch mehr Tiere krank werden. Dirks Existenz steht auf dem Spiel. Werden Maja und Julia neben den Tieren auch die Zukunft des Familienbetriebes retten konnen?

programme.title: Hubert and Staller / Hubert und Staller
programme.desc: What a gruesome find for Hubert and Staller: The attractive brewery chief Sabine Munzer was raised and put in a patch pan in her brewery in the boiler house. For Hubert and Staller it is clear: that was not a chance. In the autopsy there is a cufflink in the neck of the murder victim with a ram motif. Apparently the murder has placed him there. If that was not a crime out of revenge! Because Sabine Munzer had many enemies in Wolfratshausen. With her brother Matthias, she had come into dispute when her father did not determine him as his successor, but the younger daughter. Sabine Munzer's Yahzorniger husband Bruno Esser also tends to jealous. Both were able to be considered as a tider. But then Riedl discovers: The mysterious cufflink from the neck of the body belongs to the well -known rock musician Wastl Fischer. When Hubert and Staller confront the artist, he believes that the button was stolen from him ten years ago. But then he brings Hubert and Staller to a new hot track, namely Jasmin Hollstein's. programme.title: Quarks in the first / Quarks im Ersten

programme.desc: For most people, everyday life mainly takes place over the earth. We rarely move deeper than in the home basement. Tiefer als in den heimischen Keller bewegen wir uns nur selten. Dabei ist der Boden unter unseren FuSSen viel wichtiger als gedacht: Als vielfaltiges Ökosystem und Speicher fur Nahrstoffe, Feuchtigkeit und Co2. Als Grundlage fur den Ackerbau und unsere Lebensmittel. Als Reservoir fur wertvolle Rohstoffe. Und als Ort, wo wir Dinge unterirdisch lagern konnen. Doch obwohl der Boden so entscheidend fur uns alle ist, wird er vielfach unterschatzt.Thomas Ranft nimmt uns mit hinab ins Erdreich und erkundet, was unter der Oberflache Deutschlands passiert.Warum wird der Boden manchmal instabil, so dass er ins Rutschen kommt oder gefahrliche Erdlocher entstehen? Wo entsteht Zusammenhalt - und wo Reibung?Adriana Juric hat sich auf die Suche nach Antworten gemacht und verschiedene Communities auf der Insel besucht - alle mit ihren eigenen Lebensweisen und Bedurfnissen. Die Donauinsel ist bestandig im Wandel: Wahrend Grillrunden seit den 2000er-Jahren immer beliebter werden, klagen Gastronomen uber weniger Kundschaft. Auch die FKK-Community schrumpft zunehmend.Einige Besucherinnen und Besucher beklagen uberfullte Grillzonen, die vor allem von migrantischen Familien genutzt werden, andere storen sich an Radfahrerinnen und Radfahrern oder empfinden die Atmosphare als unsicher. Auf den eigenen Platz auf der Insel verzichten mochte niemand.

programme.desc: Arvo Part is the Meistauf-Runzen composer in the world and known for his unique Tintinnabuli style. Simplicity, spiritual depth and structural clarity characterize his music. In order to close this piece, the Arvo Part Center in 2018 opened a new building in Estonia and made the composer's personal archive access to the public. Einfachheit, spirituelle Tiefe und strukturelle Klarheit charakterisieren seine Musik. Obwohl er groSSe internationale Aufmerksamkeit genieSSt, besteht immer noch Bedarf an einer umfassenderen Erforschung und Interpretation seiner Kompositionen. Um diese Lucke zu schlieSSen, eroffnete das Arvo Part Zentrum 2018 ein neues Gebaude in Estland und machte das personliche Archiv des Komponisten auch der Öffentlichkeit zuganglich.Im Dokumentarfilm erlautern die Ehefrau des Komponisten, Nora Part, sowie die Mitarbeiter:innen des Zentrums die Beweggrunde fur die Grundung des Zentrums. Auch der Architekt dieses einzigartigen Bauwerks sowie Arvo Part selbst kommen zu Wort und erzahlen, inwiefern die Architektur des Gebaudes die schopferische Einstellung des Komponisten wiedergibt.

programme.title: Country life / Landleben
programme.desc: The Traunviertel, which can come up with scenic protecting such as the Hollengebirge, the Traunsee or the Gosautal, to the cheapest spots in the Salzkammergut. Die dorfliche Struktur der Gemeinden und die Tatsache, dass viele Einheimische hier bereits uber Generationen ansassig und daher miteinander gut bekannt sind, tragen zum gemutlichen und sympathischen Gesamteindruck des Lebens hier bei. Gestalter Wolfgang Winkler hat sich fur diese Landleben-Neuproduktion in der Region umgesehen und mehrere Originale bei ihrem Alltag begleitet: etwa Goldhaubenfrauen und Hammerherren bei einer Kutschenfahrt mit Michael Hofstatter durch die Landschaft des Traunviertels, den Jager Hans Schmidhuber bei einem Spaziergang durch den Wald, die Krauterfrau Rita Lackinger bei einem Rundgang durch die sommerliche Blumenwiese oder im Handwerksmuseum mit Peter Kerbl, der allerlei alte Schatze zeigt, von alten Bauernhandwerken bis hin zu einer historischen Holzturensammlung.

programme.title: Harrys liabste Huttn / Harrys liabste Huttn
programme.desc: In Solden in Tyrol, the ski races take place every year that open the World Cup winter. Harry Prunster is on the road in this traditional ski area and visits the siblings Matthias Gstrein and Manuela Jakob on the red hut. The father of the two, Eugen Grein, bought a shelter for the cattle in 1939 in 2666 meters of Seehohe. Then the first simple hat was built, and the square was gradually opened. The Lople-Alm has been around since 1741, in 1960 a hat was opened for the first time and since 1987 it has been managed by the landlords Hermann and Gertrud Plorer. Son Christoph serves Harry the house speciality, the so-called Ziachkriacherln, which are either eaten with sauerkraut or with cranberries. In the Giggi tente, Harry is received by Stefan and Carola Klotz. Carola worked early in the parents' petrol station, Stefan in the father's carpentry. When building the Tenne ten years ago, Stefan did everything from the table to the roof structure. Wild dishes from their own hunt, Spatzle, Bauerngrostl, a Kaiserschmarrenpfandl, apple strudel and much more there are for the hungry guest. / In Solden in Tirol finden jedes Jahr die Skirennen statt, die den Weltcupwinter eroffnen. In diesem traditionsreichen Skigebiet ist Harry Prunster unterwegs und besucht auf der Rotkogelhutte die Geschwister Matthias Gstrein und Manuela Jakob. Der Vater der beiden, Eugen Gstrein, hat 1939 in 2666 Meter Seehohe einen Unterstand fur das Vieh gekauft. Dann wurde die erste einfache Hutte gebaut, und nach und nach wurde der Platz erschlossen.Die Lople-Alm gibt es seit 1741, 1960 wurde hier zum ersten Mal eine Hutte eroffnet und seit 1987 wird sie von den Wirtsleuten Hermann und Gertrud Plorer bewirtschaftet. Sohn Christoph serviert Harry die Hausspezialitat, die sogenannten Ziachkriacherln, die entweder mit Sauerkraut oder mit Preiselbeeren gegessen werden.In der Giggi-Tenne wird Harry von Stefan und Carola Klotz empfangen. Carola hat fruher in der elterlichen Tankstelle gearbeitet, Stefan in der Zimmerei des Vaters. Beim Bau der Tenne vor zehn Jahren hat Stefan vom Tisch bis zum Dachstuhl alles selbst gemacht. Wildgerichte aus der eigenen Jagd, Spatzle, Bauerngrostl, ein Kaiserschmarrenpfandl, Apfelstrudel und vieles mehr gibts fur die hungrigen Gaste.

programme.title: Culture today / Kultur Heute
WETTER/INFO / WETTER/INFO
Land of the mountains / Land der Berge
programme.desc: As is well known, opposites attract; So also in Vorarlberg. Because if you are traveling around Bludenz with the mountain bike, you not only experience a region full of variety, but also meet a very special human beat. Funf Taler, four stages, 178 kilometers and a proud 5,300 high meters-in this "Land of the Mountains" production, everything revolves around the Vorarlberg Alpine region on two raders. The first stop is still a real high point: the Lunersee is at the foot of the Schesaplana massif in the Ratikon and is considered one of the barnest lakes in the Alps. The visit to the Brandnertal, in the first bike park in Vorarlberg, is somewhat more daring. Here, courageous cycling enthusiasts expand their skill - so can be used to try out high springs, the driving over strong traps and over gnarled root network. The next stage goes into the big Walsertal; An excursion to the biosphere park there, past colorful, light-luminous carpets and crystal-clear waters, is also an extraordinary pleasure on the bike. Redy treats attract the last section of the tour, the destination of which is in the Montafon. In the middle of the fascinating mountains can be found here an managed alpe, on which more than thirty cows spend their summer freshness. At 1,730 meters of Seehohe, the fresh milk is processed directly into butter and the typical Montafoner Sauerkase there. Producer Toni Silberberger Ladt is on a varied journey between adventures and unforgettable moments, which runs through the Brandnertal, the Walgau, the Klostertal, the Montafon and the Biosphalepark Grosses Walsertal. / Gegensatze ziehen sich bekanntlich an; so auch in Vorarlberg. Denn wer rund um Bludenz mit dem Mountainbike unterwegs ist, erlebt nicht nur eine Region voller Abwechslung, sondern trifft ebenso auf einen ganz besonderen Menschenschlag. Funf Taler, vier Etappen, 178 Kilometer und stolze 5.300 Hohenmeter - in dieser "Land der Berge"-Produktion dreht sich alles um die Erkundung der Alpenregion Vorarlberg auf zwei Radern.Bereits der erste Halt offenbart einen wahren Hohepunkt: Der Lunersee liegt am FuSSe des Schesaplana-Massivs im Ratikon und gilt als einer der schonsten Seen der Alpen. Etwas waghalsiger gestaltet sich der Besuch im Brandnertal, im ersten Bikepark Vorarlbergs. Hier erweitern mutige Radsport-Begeisterte ihre Geschicklichkeit - so konnen hohe Sprunge, das Fahren uber starke Gefalle und uber knorrige Wurzelgeflechte erprobt werden. Die nachste Etappe fuhrt in das GroSSe Walsertal; ein Ausflug in den dortigen Biospharenpark, vorbei an bunt-leuchtenden Blutenteppichen und kristallklaren Gewassern, ist auch auf dem Rad ein auSSerordentlicher Genuss. Wurzige Leckerbissen locken zum letzten Abschnitt der Tour, deren Ziel im Montafon liegt. Mitten in der faszinierenden Bergwelt ist hier eine bewirtschaftete Alpe zu finden, auf der mehr als dreiSSig Kuhe ihre Sommerfrische verbringen. Auf 1.730 Metern Seehohe wird die frische Milch in der dortigen Kaserei direkt zu Butter und dem typischen Montafoner Sauerkase verarbeitet.Der Produzent Toni Silberberger ladt auf eine abwechslungsreiche Reise zwischen Abenteuern und unvergesslichen Momenten ein, die durch das Brandnertal, den Walgau, das Klostertal, das Montafon und den Biospharenpark GroSSes Walsertal fuhrt.

programme.title: Land of the mountains / Land der Berge
programme.desc: Vorarlberg's impressive alpine landscapes are the focus of this "Land of Mountains" new production. From the jointly cultivated pram in front of the foreman in the Bregenzerwald over the picturesque Batzen Alpe on Lake Korbersee to the Sporaalpe in Tschagguns, which is known for its special Sauerkase - every alpine pasture has its own history and characteristics. The documentation illuminates the life of the Älpler, the muzzful everyday life of the dairies and the close connection between humans, animals and nature. The Alpe Erles Finne in Egg, which is managed by a family with its own cattle, also shows how alpineering is still operated with heart and devotion today. In Vorarlberg, over 500 Alps are managed, on which around 40,000 animals spend the summer every year. The alpine economy is an essential part of regional agriculture and makes a significant contribution to maintaining and maintaining the alpine cultural landscape. This production is a homage to the protective and originality of the Alps and offers fascinating insights into a world that was characterized by generations. / Vorarlbergs beeindruckende Almlandschaften stehen im Mittelpunkt dieser "Land der Berge"-Neuproduktion. Von der gemeinschaftlich bewirtschafteten VorsaSS Vorderhopfreben im Bregenzerwald uber die malerische Batzen Alpe am Korbersee bis hin zur Sporaalpe in Tschagguns, die fur ihren besonderen Sauerkase bekannt ist - jede Alm hat ihre eigene Geschichte und Charakteristik. Die Dokumentation beleuchtet das Leben der Älpler, den muhevollen Alltag der Sennereien und die enge Verbindung zwischen Mensch, Tier und Natur. Auch die Alpe Erles Finne in Egg, die von einer Familie mit eigenem Vieh bewirtschaftet wird, zeigt, wie Almbewirtschaftung heute noch mit Herz und Hingabe betrieben wird. In Vorarlberg werden uber 500 Alpen bewirtschaftet, auf denen jahrlich rund 40.000 Tiere den Sommer verbringen. Die Alpwirtschaft ist ein essenzieller Bestandteil der regionalen Landwirtschaft und tragt maSSgeblich zur Pflege und Erhaltung der alpinen Kulturlandschaft bei. Diese Produktion ist eine Hommage an die Schonheit und Ursprunglichkeit der Alpen und bietet faszinierende Einblicke in eine Welt, die von Generationen gepragt wurde.

programme.title: Fate days of Austria / Schicksalstage Österreichs
programme.desc: In the new episode of "Austria's" Fate Days ", ORF III is devoted to one of the most drastic moments of young history. The documentation of Judith Doppler reconstructs the dramatic days in early September 2015 when tens of thousands of escape lodges came to Austria - and political, moral and logistical systems reached their limits. A few days earlier, the disadvantage of Parndorf had shown with more than 70 dead that the migration movement and its supporting modes had arrived in the heart of Europe. At the center of the documentation are the crisis management of Federal Chancellor Werner Faymann and the diplomatic negotiations with Viktor Orban, Angela Merkel and EU Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker. Today's Lower Easter General Governor Johanna Mikl-Leitner remembers the tensions inside the government. Christian Kern, Sebastian Kurz and Michael Haupl describe their view of the political and human challenges of these weeks. Journalist Rainer Nowak and author Susanne Scholl classify the events in the larger European context. The film also shows the other side of this state of emergency: the spontaneous willingness to help. At the Vienna Central Station, "Train of Hope" is created with an initiative that quickly becomes a symbol. Take over thousands of volunteers that state structures cannot cope with. In interviews with representatives of various aid organizations, as well as talking with refugees, the documentation also illuminates the human aspects of these dramatic weeks. From October 2015, the focus is relocated to playing field in Styria. Pictures of chaotic scenes are the public perception - and cause the mood in the country. The discussion about a fence along Austria's borders leads to the word of the year "structural measure", but also illustrates how torn the country is now in the question of migration policy. Spaded with the striking of Paris in November 2015, the debate changed sustainably. What was decided within a few weeks at the time has been re -effect on today - and a decade also asks the question of how Europe wants to deal with flight, security and integration. / In der neuen Folge von "Schicksalstage Österreichs" widmet sich ORF III einem der einschneidendsten Momente der jungeren Geschichte. Die Dokumentation von Judith Doppler rekonstruiert die dramatischen Tage Anfang September 2015, als zehntausende Fluchtlinge uber Ungarn nach Österreich gelangten - und politische, moralische wie logistische Systeme an ihre Grenzen stieSSen.Schon wenige Tage zuvor hatte das Ungluck von Parndorf mit mehr als 70 Toten gezeigt, dass die Migrationsbewegung und ihre Tragodien im Herzen Europas angekommen waren. Im Zentrum der Dokumentation stehen das Krisenmanagement von Bundeskanzler Werner Faymann und die diplomatischen Verhandlungen mit Viktor Orban, Angela Merkel und EU-Kommissionsprasident Jean-Claude Juncker.Wahrend die Dublin-Regelung de facto auSSer Kraft gesetzt wird, ringt Europa um eine gemeinsame Linie - unter dem Druck von Bildern, die um die Welt gehen. Die heutige niederosterreichische Landeshauptfrau Johanna Mikl-Leitner erinnert sich an die Spannungen im Inneren der Regierung. Christian Kern, Sebastian Kurz und Michael Haupl schildern ihre Sicht auf die politischen und menschlichen Herausforderungen dieser Wochen. Journalist Rainer Nowak und Autorin Susanne Scholl ordnen die Ereignisse im groSSeren europaischen Kontext ein.Der Film zeigt aber auch die andere Seite dieses Ausnahmezustands: die spontane Hilfsbereitschaft. Am Wiener Hauptbahnhof entsteht mit "Train of Hope" eine Initiative, die rasch zum Symbol wird. Tausende Freiwillige ubernehmen, was staatliche Strukturen nicht bewaltigen konnen. In Interviews mit Vertreterinnen und Vertretern verschiedener Hilfsorganisationen, sowie Gesprachen mit gefluchteten Personen, beleuchtet die Dokumentation auch die menschlichen Aspekte dieser dramatischen Wochen.Ab Oktober 2015 verlagert sich der Brennpunkt nach Spielfeld in der Steiermark. Bilder von chaotischen Szenen pragen die offentliche Wahrnehmung - und verandern die Stimmung im Land. Die Diskussion uber einen Zaun entlang Österreichs Grenzen fuhrt zum Unwort des Jahres "Bauliche MaSSnahme", verdeutlicht aber auch, wie zerrissen das Land mittlerweile in der Frage der Migrationspolitik ist. Ausgerechnet als die Nerven schon blank liegen, erlebt die Familie ihre schwerste Belastungsprobe.Endlich zur Ruhe kommen, nichts wunscht sich Pastorengattin Claudia sehnlicher! Schon oft hat sein politischer Einsatz ihrem Mann Manfred Probleme eingebrockt. Ein beschauliches Dorf nahe Hamburg soll der Familie den erhofften harmonischen Neustart ermoglichen. Doch als aus der benachbarten Strafanstalt mehrere Haftlinge ausbrechen und in der Kirche des Pastors nach verstecktem Raubgut suchen, nimmt das Verhangnis unaufhaltsam seinen Lauf.

programme.title: Experience / Erlebnis Buhne
programme.desc: One of the great Esterreichische National symbols, the Vienna State Opera, was newly bought from the treumers of the Second World War 70 years ago. In the documentation, those contemporary witnesses who have witnessed the new beginning have their say: artists like Waldemar Kmentt, who sung the first tone in the new house in the "Fidelio" in 1955, Sena Jurinac, who was found at the time of the bombing goal of the State Opera, also among other Elisabeth Schwarzkopf, Christa Ludwig and Karl Lobbl. The documentation clears up with the spell that the opera is said to have been victims of confusion with the Westbahnhof. In addition, the film has given the fact that there were violent tendencies after the war to tear the opera ruins away and replace it with a new building. / Eines der groSSen osterreichischen Nationalsymbole, die Wiener Staatsoper, ist vor 70 Jahren aus den Trummern des Zweiten Weltkrieges neu erstanden. In der Dokumentation kommen jene Zeitzeugen zu Wort, die den Neuanfang miterlebt haben: Kunstler wie Waldemar Kmentt, der bei der Wiedereroffnung 1955 im "Fidelio" den ersten Ton im neuen Haus gesungen hat, Sena Jurinac, die sich zum Zeitpunkt des Bombentreffers im Keller der Staatsoper befunden hat, ferner unter anderen Elisabeth Schwarzkopf, Christa Ludwig und Karl Lobl. Die Dokumentation raumt mit dem Gerucht auf, wonach die Oper Opfer einer Verwechslung mit dem Westbahnhof gewesen sein soll. AuSSerdem erzahlt der Film, dass es nach dem Krieg heftige Tendenzen gegeben hat, die Opernruine weg zu reiSSen und durch einen Neubau zu ersetzen.

Kalkofe in the synchronized version the main character and again wrote to the dubbing book primarily. / Im Jahr 1981 wird der franzosische Superspion OSS 117 aussortiert - bis er in Afrika einen neuen Jungkollegen retten sowie einen Prasidenten an der Macht halten soll.Weder geschuttelt noch geruhrt, sondern arrogant, unverschamt, selbstverliebt und politisch unkorrekt - das ist Frankreichs komische Antwort auf James Bond mit Oscarpreistrager Jean Dujardin ("The Artist") in der Titelrolle.Das Jahr 1981 bringt fur den soeben in Afghanistan aus sowjetischer Gefangenschaft entflohenen, franzosischen Geheimagenten Hubert Bonisseur de La Bath alias OSS 117 (Jean Dujardin) einen herben Umbruch mit sich: Nicht nur droht seinem geliebten Heimatland mit François Mitterrand ein "Kommunist" im Élysee-Palast, sondern vor allem wird der selbstverliebte Spion von seinem Vorgesetzten Armand (Wladimir Yordanoff) aufs Abstellgleis geschoben.Denn wahrend der neue, technikaffine und Jeans tragende Jungkollege Serge alias OSS 1001 (Pierre Niney) in geheimer Mission nach Afrika reist, wird OSS 117 zur Digitalisierung von Akten in den Keller degradiert - und findet Gefallen daran!Doch nach wenigen Wochen soll OSS 117 die Lesebrille bereits wieder beiseitelegen, denn OSS 1001 ist spurlos verschwunden. Denn zum einen fiel die Agentenfilm-Persiflage nie zuvor so actionreich aus wie in dem neuesten Ableger, und zum anderen hat sich mit Nicolas Bedos ("Die schonste Zeit unseres Lebens") ein neuer Regisseur der Reihe angenommen, deren politisch unkorrekten und frechen Drehbucher jedoch weiterhin aus der Feder von Jean-François Halin stammen.Kontinuitat ist auch bei der Titelrolle geboten, denn erneut tobt sich der franzosische Starschauspieler Jean Dujardin ("The Artist", "November") als OSS 117 aus und erhalt in "OSS 117 - LiebesgruSSe aus Afrika" mit dem franzosischen Nachwuchsstar Pierre Niney ("Yves Saint Laurent", "Black Box - Gefahrliche Wahrheit") einen prominenten Sidekick.Wie schon bei den ersten beiden Filmen spricht der deutsche Starkomiker Oliver Kalkofe in der Synchronfassung die Hauptfigur und schrieb auch erneut hauptverantwortlich am Synchronbuch mit.

Die verheimlicht ihrem langjahrigen Freund, dass sie kurz zuvor mit Fabian Hartmann (Philipp Boos) geschlafen hat. Tom will als Botschaftsattache in New York anfangen, Laura soll ihn begleiten, er will eine Familie grunden. Lauras Begeisterung halt sich in Grenzen.Von Inspektor Castells erhalt Laura Jays Taucheruhr, die im Besitz des vermeintlichen Taters war, und ubergibt sie seinem Vater Colin (Danny Sapani). Doch die Uhr ist nicht die richtige, die Gravur auf der Ruckseite fehlt. Der als Jays Morder verhaftete Tursteher wird im Gefangnis krankenhausreif geschlagen. Laura und auch Castells - von Colin ganz zu schweigen - sind sich ziemlich sicher, dass der durch einen Tipp von Fabian Hartmann der Polizei quasi auf dem Silbertablett servierte Morder ein Tauschungsmanover ist. Womoglich soll GroSSeres vertuscht werden als der Mord an einem britischen Barmanager.Dies bestatigt sich, als Zeugin Lola (Mireia Vilapuig) in der Kanzlei von Mariona (Laia Costa) auftaucht, die Anwaltin beschimpft und mehr Geld will, wovon Castells erfahrt. Das macht nicht nur Fabian und Mariona, sondern auch Lauras Chef Generalkonsul Henderson (Steven Cree) sehr nervos. Denn die "Hochzeit" ruckt naher, das geheimnisvolle, sprachlich codierte GroSSereignis krimineller Natur. Henderson versucht deshalb, die Allianz zwischen Laura und Castells zu sprengen und behauptet ihr gegenuber, der spanische Inspektor sei korrupt.

programme.title: Painted the sick / Beruhmte Kranke
programme.desc: Diseases can meet every meeting, including celebrities. Often artists, politicians or royals try to hide their suffering from the public. What happens when the press finds out? Whether Freddie Mercury, Empress Soraya or John F. Kennedy: They secretly suffered from illnesses. What influence did their ailments have on their life, their career - maybe even on world history? "Terra X History" follows the traces of the sick. A particularly strict education should compensate for this flaw. In the event of public appearances and in photos, he always tried to hide the impairment. Historians and doctors agree: Wilhelm II. From this developed an inferiority complex. Did that also have an impact on his policy? US prasident John F. Kennedy was considered a charming, vital politician. He was celebrated like a pop star. Kennedy always kept secret in front of the public that he had suffered from spinal muscle atrophy since his most early childhood. Strong medication made a dependency; The overdose in turn to further bodied impairments. In order to keep on his feet at all in the event of public appearances, the US Prasident secretly wore a corset. If this cost him life on November 22, 1963 in Dallas? The Persian Empress Soraya seemed to be a carefree life in luxury and wealth. But she also hid a secret: after a severe typhoid disease, the second wife of Shah suffered from childlessness. Even specialist doctors could not help. After seven years of marriage, the emperor separated from her, married again to maintain the desired heir. Soraya had to leave the Persian farm. Fredddie Mercury, who was infected with the Death Virus HIV, only made his illness after years of hiding game - but only one day before his death. The Mexican Frida Kalho suffered serious injuries during a bus huck, which she captivated for months and caused chronic pain. Painting became a lifeline for her, her pictures to express suffering and strong. / Krankheiten konnen jeden treffen, auch Promis. Oft versuchen Kunstler, Politiker oder Royals, ihre Leiden vor der Öffentlichkeit zu verbergen. Was geschieht, wenn die Presse davon erfahrt?Ob Freddie Mercury, Kaiserin Soraya oder John F. Kennedy: Sie litten heimlich an Krankheiten. Welchen Einfluss hatten ihre Gebrechen auf ihr Leben, ihre Karriere - vielleicht sogar auf die Weltgeschichte? "Terra X History" geht den Spuren beruhmter Kranker nach.Kaiser Wilhelm II. litt aufgrund eines Geburtsfehlers Zeit seines Lebens an einem verkurzten linken Arm. Eine besonders strenge Erziehung sollte diesen Makel ausgleichen. Bei offentlichen Auftritten und auf Fotos versuchte er stets, die Beeintrachtigung zu verstecken. Historiker und Ärzte sind sich einig: Wilhelm II. entwickelte daraus einen Minderwertigkeitskomplex. Hatte das auch Auswirkungen auf seine Politik?US-Prasident John F. Kennedy galt als charmanter, vitaler Politiker. Er wurde gefeiert wie ein Popstar. Dass er seit seiner fruhesten Kindheit an spinaler Muskelatrophie litt, hielt Kennedy stets vor der Öffentlichkeit geheim. Starke Medikamente fuhrten zur Abhangigkeit; die Überdosierung wiederum zu weiteren korperlichen Beeintrachtigungen. Um sich bei offentlichen Auftritten uberhaupt auf den Beinen halten zu konnen, trug der US-Prasident heimlich ein Stutzkorsett. Kostete ihn dies am 22. November 1963 in Dallas das Leben?Die persische Kaiserin Soraya schien ein unbeschwertes Leben in Luxus und Reichtum zu fuhren. Doch auch sie verbarg ein Geheimnis: Nach einer schweren Typhus-Erkrankung litt die zweite Ehefrau des Schahs unter Kinderlosigkeit. Auch Facharzte konnten nicht helfen. Nach sieben Jahren Ehe trennte sich der Kaiser von ihr, heiratete erneut, um den ersehnten Erben zu erhalten. Soraya musste den persischen Hof verlassen.Freddie Mercury, der sich mit dem todlichen Virus HIV ansteckte, machte seine Krankheit erst nach jahrelangem Versteckspiel offentlich - allerdings erst einen Tag vor seinem Tod.Die Mexikanerin Frida Kalho erlitt bei einem Busungluck schwere Verletzungen, die sie monatelang ans Bett fesselten und chronische Schmerzen verursachten. Die Malerei wurde fur sie zum Rettungsanker, ihre Bilder zum Ausdruck von Leid und Starke.

programme.desc: The series intended for our youngest population is conceived to popularize and propagate a healthy lifestyle through sports and proper nutrition. We want to draw attention to the potential belonging to us, which is indisputable, the potential that deserves much more. / Serijal namijenjen našoj najmlađoj populaciji koncipiran je da popularizuje i propagira zdrav način života kroz sport i pravilnu ishranu. programme.title: Women's Volleyball: Women's Volleyball World Championship (semi-finals and final) (direct) / Voleibol Feminino: Campeonato do Mundo de Voleibol Feminino (Meias-Finais e Final) (Direto)
programme.desc: The Women's Volleyball Championship runs from August 22 to September 7 in Thailand. With a reformulated format and a record number of teams, the competition promises to be an unforgettable spectacle for the FAS from around the world. For the first time in history, 32 national teams, divided into eight groups of four, will fight for the world title. The competition, which is played every two years, will have its group stage games held in four host cities: Bangkok, Nakhon Ratchasima, Phuket and Chiang Mai. The elimination phase will be disputed entirely in banguecoque. This historical edition brings several news, such as the debut of Sweden and Slovakia in the competition, and the return of teams such as Egypt and France after feature films. The group stage runs until August 27, promising 48 intense games that will decide the 16 selections that advance to the elimination phase. The final, which will crown the new world champions, is scheduled for September 7 in Bangkok. / O Campeonato do Mundo de Voleibol Feminino decorre de 22 de agosto a 07 de setembro na Tailândia. Com um formato reformulado e um número recorde de equipas, a competiçao promete ser um espetáculo inesquecível para os fas de todo o mundo. Pela primeira vez na historia, 32 seleções nacionais, divididas em oito grupos de quatro, lutarao pelo título mundial. A competiçao, que se disputa a cada dois anos, terá os seus jogos da fase de grupos realizados em quatro cidades anfitrias: Banguecoque, Nakhon Ratchasima, Phuket e Chiang Mai. A fase de eliminaçao será disputada inteiramente em Banguecoque. Esta ediçao historica traz várias novidades, como a estreia da Suecia e da Eslováquia na competiçao, e o regresso de equipas como o Egipto e a França apos longas ausencias. A fase de grupos decorre ate 27 de Agosto, prometendo 48 jogos intensos que decidirao as 16 seleções que avançam para a fase de eliminaçao. A final, que coroará as novas campeas mundiais, está marcada para 7 de Setembro em Banguecoque.

programme.title: Heidi / Heidi
programme.desc: When the young Adelheid "Heidi" gets orfa, Aunt Detie takes her to live with her grandfather Alp, who lives isolated in the high alpine mountains. Initially reluctant to take care of Heidi, the grandfather quickly develops a deep affection for the granddaughter. Heidi adapts quickly to his new life, especially accompanying the young pastor of goats Peter. When Aunt Detie returns in the next summer to take her back to the city, Heidi does not want to go and her grandfather is not willing to give up her new "family". But the aunt is relentless, as he promised Heidi to a rich family to accompany his sick daughter, Clara, after school hours. Heidi and Clara approach, but after a few months, Heidi misses his grandfather and the high mountains. / Quando a jovem Adelheid "Heidi" fica orfa, a tia Detie leva-a para viver com o avô Alp, que vive isolado nas altas montanhas alpinas. Inicialmente relutante em cuidar de Heidi, o avô rapidamente desenvolve um profundo afeto pela neta. Heidi adapta-se rapidamente à sua nova vida, especialmente acompanhando o jovem pastor de cabras Peter. Quando a tia Detie regressa no verao seguinte para a levar de volta para a cidade, Heidi nao quer ir e o avô tambem nao está disposto a abdicar da sua nova "família". Mas a tia e implacável, pois prometeu Heidi a uma família rica para acompanhar a sua filha doente, Clara, apos o horário escolar. Heidi e Clara aproximam-se, mas passados alguns meses, Heidi sente saudades do avô e das altas montanhas.

programme.title: Mechanical orange, the mechanisms of violence / Laranja Mecânica, os Mecanismos da Violencia
programme.desc: In 1971, the British Anthony Burgess, author of the scandalous romance The Mechanical Orange, was criticized by all when Stanley Kubrick's movie was premiered. The public, the critics and some American judges were outraged. Under the spotlight and accused of inciting violence and murder, Burgess began writing a manuscript, which was never published and now exclusively revealed, in which he intended to explain once and for all the origins of this misunderstood work and reflect on the excessive violence in modern societies and the risks of equally violent institutional responses ... a true antidote to the danger of authoritarianism and the paranoia of security. Until his death in 1993, Anthony Burgess remained haunted by the misunderstanding that fell on his book. With the narrative thread of his unexpected appeal, discovered in 2019, and enlightening testimonies, including that of British writer Will Self, the documentary explores the multiple repercussions of a brilliant and visionary work, where humor attenuates the darkness, to show quao central and the question of free will. / Em 1971, o britânico Anthony Burgess, autor do escandaloso romance A Laranja Mecânica, foi criticado por todos quando o filme de Stanley Kubrick foi estreado. O público, os críticos e alguns juízes americanos ficaram indignados. Sob os holofotes e acusado de incitar a violencia e assassínio, Burgess começou a escrever um manuscrito, que nunca foi publicado e e agora revelado em exclusivo, no qual pretendia explicar de uma vez por todas as origens dessa obra incompreendida e refletir sobre os excessos de violencia nas sociedades modernas e os riscos de respostas institucionais igualmente violentas... Um verdadeiro antídoto para o perigo do autoritarismo e a paranoia da segurança. Ate à sua morte, em 1993, Anthony Burgess permaneceu assombrado pelo mal-entendido que se abateu sobre o seu livro. Com o fio narrativo do seu apelo inedito, descoberto em 2019, e testemunhos esclarecedores, incluindo o do escritor britânico Will Self, o documentário explora as múltiplas repercussões de uma obra brilhante e visionária, onde o humor atenua a escuridao, para mostrar quao central e a questao do livre arbítrio.

programme.title: Women's Volleyball: Women's Volleyball World Championship (semi-finals and final) (direct) / Voleibol Feminino: Campeonato do Mundo de Voleibol Feminino (Meias-Finais e Final) (Direto)
programme.desc: The Women's Volleyball Championship runs from August 22 to September 7 in Thailand. With a reformulated format and a record number of teams, the competition promises to be an unforgettable spectacle for the FAS from around the world. For the first time in history, 32 national teams, divided into eight groups of four, will fight for the world title. The competition, which is played every two years, will have its group stage games held in four host cities: Bangkok, Nakhon Ratchasima, Phuket and Chiang Mai. The elimination phase will be disputed entirely in banguecoque. This historical edition brings several news, such as the debut of Sweden and Slovakia in the competition, and the return of teams such as Egypt and France after feature films. The group stage runs until August 27, promising 48 intense games that will decide the 16 selections that advance to the elimination phase. The final, which will crown the new world champions, is scheduled for September 7 in Bangkok. / O Campeonato do Mundo de Voleibol Feminino decorre de 22 de agosto a 07 de setembro na Tailândia. Com um formato reformulado e um número recorde de equipas, a competiçao promete ser um espetáculo inesquecível para os fas de todo o mundo. Pela primeira vez na historia, 32 seleções nacionais, divididas em oito grupos de quatro, lutarao pelo título mundial. A competiçao, que se disputa a cada dois anos, terá os seus jogos da fase de grupos realizados em quatro cidades anfitrias: Banguecoque, Nakhon Ratchasima, Phuket e Chiang Mai. A fase de eliminaçao será disputada inteiramente em Banguecoque. Esta ediçao historica traz várias novidades, como a estreia da Suecia e da Eslováquia na competiçao, e o regresso de equipas como o Egipto e a França apos longas ausencias. A fase de grupos decorre ate 27 de Agosto, prometendo 48 jogos intensos que decidirao as 16 seleções que avançam para a fase de eliminaçao. A final, que coroará as novas campeas mundiais, está marcada para 7 de Setembro em Banguecoque.

Jiří Suchý: Recital 1964 | 2019 / Jiří Suchý: Recitál 1964|2019
programme.desc: "Anyway, we have to play in Rudolfinum once. There is always a well -tuned piano, and then, that's the main one, go there nice people," says Jiří Šlitr in the intermediate of the song "Three Aunts". The festival of the autumn of the autumn fulfilled Šlitr's wishes on the occasion of 50 years since his death by a project, whose center is the second half of the famous couple, living classic Jiří Suchý / "Stejně, musíme si jednou zahrát v Rudolfinu. Tam bejvá vždycky slušně naladěný piáno, a potom, to je to hlavní, tam choděj fajnový lidi," říká v mezihře písně "Tři tety" Jiří Šlitr. Festival Struny podzimu splnil Šlitrovo přání při příležitosti 50 let od jeho úmrtí projektem, jehož středobodem je druhá polovina slavne dvojice, žijící klasik Jiří Suchý

programme.title: I'm not yet who I want to be / Ještě nejsem, kým chci být
programme.desc: A unique documentary about photographer Libuš Jarcovjákov, who exposes her life journey and consists only of her photographs and diary notes. The film was awarded the Czech Lion and the Czech Film Critics Award and ČFTA was selected as an Oscar candidate in the Best International Film category (hook subtitles) / Jedinečný dokument o fotografce Libuši Jarcovjákove, který obnažuje její životní cestu a je tvořen pouze jejími fotografiemi a deníkovými zápisky. Snímek byl oceněn Českým lvem a Cenou česke filmove kritiky a ČFTA byl vybrán jako kandidát na Oscara v kategorii nejlepší mezinárodní film (skryte titulky)

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/26
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Nogomet (M): Werder B. - B. Leverkusen, Bundesliga 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Werder B. - B. Leverkusen, Bundesliga 2025/26
programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, which start matches for a popular plate every year in August. It was most often won by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The cheerleading culture, full of tribes and top football is what Bundesliga adorns from its beginnings to the present day. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy the Bundesliga matches. You will definitely not be sorry. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. Ne zamudite priložnosti, da uživate v tekmah Bundeslige. Zagotovo vam ne bo žal.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/26
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991 after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/26
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991 after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Good morning, Mon. / Dobro jutro, pon.
programme.sub-title: Petkova oddaja Dobro jutro bo tudi v novi sezoni pisana na kožo vsem, ki želijo dan začeti z nasmehom, koristnimi informacijami, v sproščenem vzdušju. V prvi uri najprej preverjamo, kaj je aktualnega doma in po svetu, pred osmo ponudimo praktične nasvet
programme.desc: Below we focus on minor health problems and solutions. A special place has a culinary section of cooking minutes, where we highlight traditional Slovenian dishes and reveal useful tricks on how to prepare them in a simple but delicious way. As Friday morning, there will be no lack of musical greetings and congratulations that bring the right measure of warmth and a pleasant atmosphere for the weekend. The show will be full of tips, flavors and, above all, goodwill - a real accompaniment to morning coffee. / V nadaljevanju se posvetimo manjšim zdravstvenim težavam in rešitvam. Posebno mesto ima kulinarična rubrika Kuharske minute, kjer izpostavljamo tradicionalne slovenske jedi in razkrijemo uporabne trike, kako jih pripraviti na enostaven, a okusen način.Kot vsako petkovo jutro ne bodo manjkali niti glasbeni pozdravi in čestitke, ki prinašajo pravo mero topline in prijetnega vzdušja za konec tedna. Oddaja bo polna nasvetov, okusov in predvsem dobre volje – prava spremljava ob jutranji kavi.

programme.desc: This World: Burma with Simon Reeve / United Kingdom / BBC Studios / 2018. / THIS WORLD: BURMA WITH SIMON REEVE / ZDRUŽENO KRALJESTVO / BBC STUDIOS / 2018.

programme.title: Bite Science: Scientific Olympiads, Mon. / Ugriznimo znanost: Znanstvene olimpijade, pon.
programme.sub-title: Večina učencev, dijakov in študentov je bila poleti na zasluženih počitnicah. Najuspešnejši slovenski dijaki pa so se udeležili različnih olimpijad.
programme.desc: “Calculate the size of a crater made by a certain ball into the sand.” “How many times a year does the sun rise in the northern pole?” Tasks at the Scientific Olympics often do not have a simple school answer. They require linking knowledge, includes content that is not in school programs and require a research mindset. Slovenian students are very successful in these competitions. Today we are going to talk about what are scientific Olympics and what students need to know about them. / »Izračunaj velikost kraterja, ki ga v pesek naredi določena kroglica.« »Kolikokrat na leto vzide sonce na severnem polu?« Naloge na znanstvenih olimpijadah pogosto nimajo preprostega šolskega odgovora. Zahtevajo povezovanje znanja, vključujejo vsebine, ki jih ni v šolskih programih, in zahtevajo raziskovalno miselnost.Slovenski dijaki so na teh tekmovanjih zelo uspešni. Danes bomo govorili o tem, kaj so znanstvene olimpijade in kaj vse morajo dijaki znati na njih.

Automotive: Bojan Križaj drives Renault 5 GT Turbo after 36 years, Mon. / Avtomobilnost: Bojan Križaj po 36 letih vozi Renault 5 GT Turbo, pon.
programme.sub-title: Nekdanji slovenski smučarski as Bojan Križaj je v zibelki slovenskega smučanja na Blokah po 36 letih spet sedel za volan svojega nekdanjega Renaulta 5 GT Turbo.
programme.desc: The rising ski "star" Miha Hrobat, however, was sitting in an electric Audi Q6 e-tron. We compared torque vector in a car with skiing technique in turns, especially when combined with carving skis. Let's make sure you have a roof suitcase for skis that can be twisted to make it easier to clean. At sea, we are talking about the adverse effects of the anchoring of ships on the environment and the need for charging parking fees for ships. The presenter of the show Martina Kermavner Kolman tells an opinion on Toyota C-HR, and we are also presenting a new brand of Chinese cars on Slovenian roads. / Vzhajajoči smučarski »zvezdnik« Miha Hrobat pa je sedel v električni Audi Q6 E-tron. Primerjali smo vektoriranje navora v avtomobilu s smučarsko tehniko v zavojih, še posebej v kombinaciji s carving smučmi.Predstavimo vam strešni kovček za smuči, ki ga lahko zvijemo in tako lažje pospravimo. Na morju govorimo o škodljivih vplivih sidranja ladij na okolje ter potrebi po zaračunavanju parkirnin za ladje. Voditeljica oddaje Martina Kermavner Kolman pove mnenje o Toyoti C-HR, predstavljamo pa tudi novo znamko kitajskih avtomobilov na slovenskih cestah.

programme.desc: In the show Good evening, archaeologist dr. Andrej Magdic. As a researcher and conservator, he works at the Maribor Unit of the Institute for the Protection of Cultural Heritage of Slovenia. Is he the right person to answer the question, what has been happening with the space where we live in the older past today, who was here before us, how did he live, and does modern archeology also offer us answers to the questions of today? / V oddaji Dober večer bo z nami arheolog dr. Andrej Magdič. Kot raziskovalec in konservator deluje pri mariborski enoti Zavoda za varstvo kulturne dediščine Slovenije. Je prava oseba za odgovor na vprašanje, kaj se je s prostorom, kjer živimo danes dogajalo v starejši preteklosti, kdo je bil tukaj pred nami, kako je živel in ali nam sodobna arheologija ponudi tudi odgovore na vprašanja današnjega časa?

programme.title: Slovenian jazz scene: jazz party: Lisa Smirnova, RTV Slovenia Symphony Orchestra and Darko Butorac (D.SOSTAKOVIC, G.GERSHWIN), Mon. / Slovenska jazz scena: Jazz Party: Lisa Smirnova, Simfonični orkester RTV Slovenija in Darko Butorac (D.Šostakovič, G.Gershwin), pon.
programme.desc: R: Švigelj Tomaž ... RTV Slovenia Symphony Orchestra is presented with an interesting, jazz -colored program. The Suite for the Dmitry Shostakovich Promenade Orchestra and the popular Rapsody in blue George Gershwin will be scheduled. The soloist will be pianist Lisa Smirna, an Austrian musician of Russian roots. She studied music in her hometown of Moscow, and in the 1990s she studied in Salzburg and then settled in Austria permanently. After a great performance at the famous Carnegie Hall in New York and at the Salzburg Festival, she is today a guest of all the world's stage. The conductor will be Darko Butorac, who is now considered one of the most sought after young conductors. / R: Švigelj Tomaž... Simfonični orkester RTV Slovenija se predstavlja z zanimivim, džezovsko obarvanim programom. Na sporedu bosta Suita za promenadni orkester Dmitrija Šostakoviča in priljubljena Rapsodija v modrem Georgea Gershwina. Solistka bo pianistka Lisa Smirna, avstrijska glasbenica ruskih korenin. Glasbo je študirala v svojem rojstnem mestu Moskvi, v devetdesetih letih prejšnjega stoletja pa se je izpopolnjevala v Salzburgu in se potem za stalno naselila v Avstriji. Po odličnem nastopu v sloviti Carnegiejevi dvorani v New Yorku in na Salzburškem festivalu je danes gostja vseh svetovnih koncertnih odrov. Dirigent bo Darko Butorac, ki dandanes velja za enega najbolj iskanih mladih dirigentov.

programme.title: We predict / Napovedujemo
Memories: prof. dr. Niko Tosh, 1. Part, Mon. / Spomini: prof. dr. Niko Toš, 1. del, pon.
programme.desc: Lawyer and sociologist prof. dr. Nika Tosh is known by many generations of students of the Faculty of Social Sciences, and is known to the general public as the founder and head of the Center for Research of Public Opinion and Mass Communications. The first two of the four parts of the show are, through his memories and the memories of his ancestors, interesting Chronicle of Life in Slovenia in the last century on his life path from Maribor through Celje to Ljubljana, among personalities whose stories (even with valuable documentary recordings) are involved in the narrative, and are also the colonel of the royal army Draz Mihailov, Wife, sculptor Karl Bulovcev, uncle and aunt Nika Tosh, the Mrak family, from which Tosh's mother, painter and Olympian Toso Primožič and many others come from. The third and fourth parts of the memories of Nika Tosh are dedicated to the development of Slovenian and Yugoslav society through the findings of public opinion polls, and again the entire Gallery of Slovenian, Yugoslav and European figures in this field is involved in the narrative. Today, the eighty -year -old annual professor Niko Toš is an outstanding storyteller and a weighty thoughtful about society and time we live, so it is definitely worth listening to. / Pravnika in sociologa prof. dr. Nika Toša poznajo mnoge generacije študentov Fakultete za družbene vede, širša javnost pa ga pozna kot ustanovitelja in predstojnika Centra za raziskovanje javnega mnenja in množičnih komunikacij. Prva dva od štirih delov oddaje sta skozi njegove spomine ter spomine njegovih prednikov zanimiva kronika življenja na Slovenskem v zadnjem stoletju na njegovi življenjski poti od Maribora prek Celja v Ljubljano, med osebnostmi, katerih zgodbe se (tudi z dragocenimi dokumentarnimi posnetki) vpletajo v pripoved, pa so tudi polkovnik kraljeve vojske Draža Mihailovič, major Mirko Bitenc, pisatelj in dramatik Ivan Mrak in njegova žena, kiparka Karla Bulovčeva, stric in teta Nika Toša, družina Mrak, iz katere izhaja Toševa mama, slikar in olimpijec Tošo Primožič in mnogi drugi. Tretji in četrti del Spominov Nika Toša sta posvečena razvoju slovenske in jugoslovanske družbe skozi izsledke raziskav javnega mnenja in spet se v pripoved vpleta cela galerija slovenskih, jugoslovanskih in evropskih osebnosti s tega področja. Danes oseminosemdesetletni letni profesor Niko Toš je izjemen pripovednik in tehten premišljevalec o družbi in času, ki ga živimo, zato mu je vsekakor vredno prisluhniti.
